headline: Capital One card volume rose 11% while investing further in AI
body: Capital One's credit card purchase volume increased 11% year over year to $254.7 billion in the third quarter. Domestic card charge-offs fell to 3.98%, down 65 basis points from a year earlier. The bank is also investing further in generative and agentic AI.
note: For card lenders, falling charge-offs alongside higher spending is the number to watch next quarter.

figure.label: year-over-year growth in credit card purchase volume, third quarter

evidence.text: The Oct. 20 results showed that credit card purchase volume increased 11% year over year to $254.7 billion.

Capital One’s cardholders continued spending in the third quarter while credit losses declined, giving the bank room to pursue two expensive strategic priorities: building more volume on the Discover network and investing further in generative and agentic artificial intelligence.
Domestic card charge-offs fell to 3.98%, down 65 basis points from a year earlier and 73 basis points from the second quarter.
